_comment: Role return archive template. Put the finalized manifest at the USTAR archive root as return-manifest.json, remove this _comment, and include exactly the declared regular files. handoffProtocolSha256, deliverySequence, and componentDecisionCodePath are copied verbatim from the coordinator-only return plan; they do not disclose a condition identity. A role submits only one archive for this delivery. The coordinator must apply it, record the actual matching figma-gate checkpoint and same-condition feedback before any next delivery. Use a plain uncompressed USTAR archive: no PAX/GNU extension, directory, symlink, hard link, special file, or undeclared entry.
